title: Continuous Mal'cev Qp-Completion of Pro-p Groups
summary: We give three explicit constructions of the continuous Mal'cev Qp-completion of a topologically finitely generated pro-p group, using Tannakian formalism, Hopf algebras and p-adic analytic groups. We study properties of the continuous Mal'cev Qp-completion via these explicit constructions.
